summary: This bill amends the Act of May 17, 1954, to increase the authorized acreage of Gateway Arch National Park from 100 to 102.18 acres and updates the reference map for the park's boundary.

scores.thoughts: This bill revises the boundary of Gateway Arch National Park, increasing its acreage slightly. While national parks generally contribute to environmental protection, this specific boundary adjustment is a minor administrative change and not a primary environmental policy initiative of the bill.
